technical.summary: ABT shows long-term trend structure (50/200 EMA bullish) and early momentum recovery signals (RSI rising, StochRSI cross-up) but lacks confluence for swing entry; price remains below key moving averages, MACD is negative, and no triggered strategies indicate premature entry risk.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 55 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase vs 1 sale, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (382.8) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 55 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions for ABT.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (50/200 EMA bullish) + early momentum recovery (RSI rising, StochRSI cross-up) + extreme fear sentiment (21/100) creates contrarian opportunity near support (107.29).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all key moving averages, MACD negative, no triggered entry strategies, VIX crisis regime (382.8), earnings risk in 55 days, zero smart money conviction, and weak technical confluence make this premature entry with unfavorable macro backdrop.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (21/100) and long-term EMA bullish structure offer contrarian appeal, price remains below all key moving averages with negative MACD and zero triggered entry strategies, creating premature entry risk in a VIX crisis regime.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (382.8) combined with earnings event in 55 days and existing portfolio concentration (17/25 positions in Health Care, already holding ABT) creates compounding drawdown risk if macro deteriorates further.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ABT with 68% sector concentration in Health Care; adding to this position violates concentration limits and reduces conviction significantly.
